rules.rule: One question per turn; sub-questions count as separate questions
must: One question per turn, in plain prose
Sub-questions of the same topic are still separate questions

rules.rule: Never use AskUserQuestion multiple-choice unless the user asks
must: Never use `AskUserQuestion` multiple-choice unless the user asks for it
No implementation\. Planning only; don't write code
Never assume\. If something is ambiguous, ask

rules.rule: On conflicting decisions name the conflict, reopen the earlier branch, give options; never reconcile yourself
must: name the conflict, mark the earlier branch open again, and hold both until the user picks
Reconciling them yourself would record a choice they never made

rules.rule: State the count as N resolved, M open on first speaking, then as each branch closes
must: the first time you speak in this interview

rules.rule: An overturned assumption reopens every branch resting on it, named before the next question
must: that branch reopens — and so does every other one that rested on the same assumption
name each one that reopens and why in a line

rules.rule: Resolved means a pass/fail acceptance criterion can be written; the summary carries them
must: give each resolved branch the precise acceptance criteria
a branch you cannot write a pass/fail check for is not resolved

rules.rule: A branch nobody present can resolve is carried open with owner and question, not closed and not blocking the summary
must: does not block the summary and is not quietly closed either
Carry it as open with an owner and the question they must answer

rules.rule: Offer to persist via plan-smith write mode; skip the offer when another skill invoked this one
must: Offer to persist — on yes, invoke `craft:plan-smith` in write mode
When another skill invoked this one on a subject, skip the offer
